title: Interfacial energy storage in aqueous zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9018-9030
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03741G, Review Article

Yuhang Dai, Chengyi Zhang, Xinyu Zhang, Peie Jiang, Jie Chen, Wei Zong, Sicheng Zheng, Xuan Gao, Thomas J. Macdonald, Guanjie He
This review highlights interfacial strategies to accelerate Zn2+ transport and desolvation in aqueous zinc-ion batteries, and explores water dissociation pathways that unlock proton and hydroxide storage for next-generation energy storage.
